# Card Maker

> Card Maker is a static, browser-based editor for board-game card prototypes. Projects are imported, edited, and exported in the user's browser.

The hosted app is available at https://joaovpimenta.github.io/card_maker/.

## Agent documentation

- [Agent API and capabilities](agents/README.md): browser automation, lifecycle, and constraints
- [Capabilities summary](agents/capabilities.md): supported operations and readiness
- [Machine-readable capabilities catalog](agents/capabilities.json): browser API methods, commands, results, and limits
- [Project JSON Schema](agents/project.schema.json): machine-readable version 1 project contract
- [Sample project](agents/sample-project.json): importable example with template and cards
- [Sample card data](agents/sample-data.json): a small standalone dataset

## Important deployment detail

The site is hosted under `/card_maker/`. Resolve documentation links relative to the current document or use the full hosted URL. This is a static website; it does not expose a remote MCP service or server-side project API. Browser automation must run against the loaded website.
